purpose: Local paths, home directories, physical host names and a private server address were replaced by the placeholders below before publication. Result values were not edited.

line_ending_normalization.rule: The repository publishes text with LF line endings (.gitattributes: * text=auto eol=lf); CRLF was converted to LF before the checksums were computed, so the listed SHA-256 values are those of the published bytes.
